Name: Less Creepy Marnie Sprite (for Content Patcher)
Author: Reddazrael
Description:
When [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45407192]EveriasArt[/url] first posted the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1349]Less Creepy Marnie Sprite[/url] back in 2017, they said this:

[quote]Does Marnie's non-stop smiling sprite ever creep you out? This mod removes that joker smile so she looks like normal character and not like she murdered her siblings when she was 10 because of the blood thirst raging inside of her, causing her to assume a new identity and attempt to blend in with the townsfolk of Stardew Valley.[/quote]
And you know what, I couldn't have said it any better than that.

So here it is, now for Content Patcher.



[size=1][i](I reached out to EveriasArt to ask permission to upload this version for Content Patcher, but they didn't respond, and their last activity on Nexus appears to be from four years ago; therefore, I went ahead with this update. However, should they request I take it down, I will immediately do so. Thank you to EveriasArt for the original sprite edit!)[/i][/size]
